EffectInstance

The use of an Effect on an item, see item.effects, with its parameters. The parameters that the effect declares are also its properties. Instances of effects that aren’t registered keep their parameters and leave what they get as it is, so that they still round-trip.

Properties

type

The type of the effect that the instance uses, also when it isn’t registered.

Read only.

    Type:

  • String
effect

The effect that the instance uses, registered under its type, or null if there is none.

Read only.

    Type:

  • Effect⟋null
visible

Whether the effect applies. Effects that aren’t visible are skipped.

    Default:

  • true

    Type:

  • Boolean
parameters

The parameters of the instance. Changing them on the returned object updates it, as setting them as its properties does. Parameters that it doesn’t have yet are added by setting them all, as are changes within values such as arrays.

    Type:

  • Object

Example:

var instance = path.addEffect({
    type: 'offset',
    parameters: { distance: 10 }
});
instance.parameters.distance = 20; // Redraws.
instance.parameters = { distance: 5, join: 'round' };
item

The item that the instance is part of.

Read only.

    Type:

  • Item⟋null
index

The index of the instance in the item.effects of its item.

Read only.

    Type:

  • Number⟋null

Methods

remove()

Removes the instance from its item.

    Returns:

  • Boolean — true if the instance was removed, false otherwise
equals(instance)

Checks whether the instance is equal to the supplied one.

    Parameters:

  • instance: EffectInstance

    Returns:

  • Boolean — true if they are equal, false otherwise
